title: ExecutionResult v1
description: What an Execution agent returns. AGENT_CONTRACTS section 7.4. The artifacts it names are references, and the runtime verifies each one exists in the database before the stage counts as successful — a model that invents an id fails validation (AC-AGENT-003).

artifacts.description: What the stage produced, by reference. An empty list is legitimate only for a stage the runtime knows to be a no-op, which the Validation rules in section 7.4 state as 'success 至少有预期 artifact，除非该阶段明确是 no-op'.

nextAction.description: What the agent believes should happen next. It is a report, not a command: the runtime decides, and section 9 puts the state machine on the runtime's side of the line.

artifactRef.description: A reference to a row the stage wrote. The operation is reported rather than inferred so a reviewer can tell a new artifact from a superseded one.
